color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Warm ivory page background (#fcf7f1), luminance 247.8, qualifies for light color register. Black typography, navy accent (#1e3a6e).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist C. Heading font weight shift (+200): display weight 400→600, section heading weight 500→700. Helvetica Neue replaced with Space Grotesk via Google Fonts CDN (concept-matched fallback). Inter retained via Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist C. Easing curve swap: primary 'ease' → 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)' (Material standard deceleration). Applied to button transitions, accordion, overlay, and pulse animation. Gives engineered precision to motion character.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist B. Gap value scaling ×1.4: featured-post grid gap 40px → 56px. More generous editorial white space between asymmetric split columns.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C. Hero padding emphasis ×1.5: container/content/work/hero paddingTop and paddingBottom 50px → 75px. Establishes more imposing vertical breathing room in hero-adjacent sections.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E. Focus state enhancement: added outlineWidth: 2px + outlineStyle: solid + outlineOffset: 2px to all five link focus states. Enhances keyboard accessibility without changing color values.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist A. Nav height adjustment +16px (intensity 3): height 70→86px, heightScrolled 60→76px. More commanding editorial presence. 0.08em letter-spacing and underline hover animation retained from source.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C. Material shift: Section 7 (Component Styling) rewritten to emphasize tactile materiality — pressed board analogy, paper weight, surface density language. concept_by_video.md generated fresh with 3 video placements: hero-bg.mp4 (worktable drift, 10s), features-ambient.mp4 (ruling pen macro, 5s), footer-grain.mp4 (paper fiber zoom, 5s).

productConcept.name: Burnham
productConcept.tagline: Where design intent becomes buildable record.
productConcept.description: Precision specification software for architectural practices. A living specification document system that connects architectural design decisions to materials, suppliers, standards, and version history.
